jobs.title: NPI Engineer (Program Manager)
jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.

Texas Instruments is looking for an energetic engineer with a passion for process. This position provides the opportunity to drive continual improvement at all levels. Our team is primarily focused on driving improved procedures and processes. We are searching for a self-directed, highly motivated engineer to join our team.

The responsibilities of an NPI PM Engineer in this role include:

- Develops new or modified process formulations, defines processing or handling equipment requirements and specifications, and reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication, and evaluation of products.

-  Involvement may begin at any step from pilot plant to full-scale manufacturing. Coordinates design requirement review with appropriate engineering/scientific personnel to ensure compatibility of processing methods.

- Compiles and evaluates test data to determine appropriate limits and variables for process or material specifications.

- May conceive and plan projects involving definition and selection of new concepts, equipment automation technology, and approaches in the processing or development of new or improved processes

- Participate in data analysis and problem resolution
Minimum requirements:

- 2-5 years relevant experience

- Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field

- Strong foundation in statistical process control, engineering change control and process release strategies

Preferred qualifications:

- Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions

- Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

- Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment

- Ability to take the initiative and drive for result

jobs.title: Program Management Engineer
jobs.description:
Custom Team at Texas Instruments is looking for an experienced, highly driven Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional custom development programs that bring innovative semiconductor products from concept to production.

In this role, you will work closely with systems, design, operations, marketing & sales, post-silicon validation, test, quality, and very demanding customer teams to ensure successful execution of schedules, deliverables, and business goals.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership

- Being in custom development for demanding customers, execution efficacy, timeline adherence, quality control and stakeholder management need to be ensured by the Program Manager.

- Lead end-to-end program planning, execution, and delivery for analog/mixed-signal/embedded semiconductor products.

- Drive program scope, timelines, risk assessment, budgeting, and resource planning.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Coordinate with design, DV, layout, post-Si validation, test engineering, quality, packaging, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing and operations teams across global sites.

- Facilitate program reviews, technical checkpoints, and decision gates.

Schedule & Risk Management

- Create and maintain detailed program schedules using appropriate tools.

- Identify risks early, develop mitigation plans, and ensure teams stay aligned to program objectives.

Customer & Stakeholder Communication

- Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.

- Present program status, key metrics, and critical issues to leadership and customers.

Quality & Compliance

- Ensure programs meet TI’s quality, reliability, and regulatory standards along with customer mandated quality checks. Coordinate root cause analysis and corrective actions when needed.

Operational & Business Support

- Collaborate with product line management on go-to-market strategies.

- Monitor cost, yield, and performance targets throughout the product lifecycle.
Preferred Qualifications

- 5–10+ years of program/project management experience in semiconductors, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing.

- Experience managing SoC/ASIC/analog/mixed-signal or embedded product development programs (depending on team).

- Strong understanding (experience preferred) of semiconductor development flows: architecture → design → validation → test → quality checks → release to production.

- Proficiency with program management tools (Jira, MS Project, Confluence, etc.).

- Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.title: Financial Operations Director - Analytics & Compliance
jobs.description:
Business Summary
Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable (APAR) play a critical role in protecting the company’s financial assets, enabling customers and suppliers, and managing billions of dollars in financial transactions. As our operations become increasingly digital, data-driven and automated, we need strong capabilities at the intersection of finance, technology, analytics and risk.
This role offers a unique opportunity to build and scale an organization from ground up: including hiring and developing managers, establishing team structure, and creating the processes and culture that enable a function to operate independently at scale. The APAR Analytics and Compliance Director will lead a multi-layered organization responsible for strengthening how APAR uses data, technology, controls and process improvement to operate more effectively and manage risk. This role will partner across Finance, IT, Customer Operations, Sales, Procurement, Internal Audit and other organizations to modernize APAR processes while maintaining a strong global control environment.

What You’ll Do
Analytics & Data
- Lead the APAR analytics strategy and develop actionable insights that improve financial performance, operational efficiency and decision-making.
- Establish meaningful KPIs, dashboards and analytical frameworks across accounts payable and accounts receivable.
- Use transactional data to identify trends, exceptions, root causes, control gaps and improvement opportunities.
- Develop and maintain strong data governance practices, including data quality, ownership, lineage and reconciliation.
- Enable predictive and exception-based analytics to shift APAR from reactive processing toward proactive management.
- Build analytical capabilities within the team and increase effective use of data throughout APAR.

Process Improvement & Transformation
- Lead cross-functional projects focused on simplifying, standardizing and automating APAR processes.
- Evaluate existing processes and systems to identify opportunities for automation, digitization and improved controls.
- Apply process improvement methodologies and process-mining techniques to identify bottlenecks, exceptions and non-value-added activity.
- Translate business problems into technical requirements and partner with IT and other organizations to implement scalable solutions.
- Lead project governance, requirements definition, testing, implementation and change management for APAR initiatives.
- Identify opportunities to apply AI, workflow automation and emerging technologies to finance operations.

Compliance, Controls & Risk
- Own and continuously strengthen the APAR control and compliance framework.
- Ensure appropriate controls supporting SOX requirements, PCI DSS and applicable global regulatory requirements.
- Partner with Internal Audit, external auditors and business stakeholders on control design, testing and remediation.
- Design controls into processes and systems rather than relying primarily on manual detective controls.
- Establish continuous monitoring and analytics to proactively identify control failures, unusual transactions and emerging risks.
- Assess payment, fraud, data privacy, access and operational risks across APAR.
- Support segregation-of-duties, access-control and sensitive-data requirements across financial systems and processes.
- Maintain Compliance policies and procedures and ensure they reflect regulatory obligations, corporate requirements, industry best practices while also addressing new business initiatives and technology enhancements.
- Stay abreast of related industry trends and standards.

Payments & Technology
- Provide technical leadership across B2B and B2C payment processes and technologies.
- Understand payment methods and infrastructure including ACH, wires, cards, virtual cards, direct debit, payment gateways, bank interfaces, settlement and reconciliation.
- Understand system integrations including APIs, REST services, JSON, middleware, SFTP and other system-to-system interfaces.
- Partner with IT and platform teams on architecture and integration decisions affecting APAR.
- Evaluate emerging payment technologies and their implications for operational efficiency, customer/supplier experience, security and risk.
- Manages relationships with vendors, leads QBRs, participates in conferences, etc

Leadership
- Build and scale a high-performing management team
- Establish clear priorities and accountability while developing deeper technical and analytical capabilities within the team.
- Build strong partnerships across Finance, IT and business organizations.
- Communicate complex technical, financial and risk topics clearly to both technical teams and senior leadership.
- Create an environment that encourages curiosity, disciplined problem solving and continuous improvement.
- Build a culture of psychological safety, respect, and inclusion

What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means APAR becomes increasingly data-driven, automated, controlled and scalable. The organization has reliable data and meaningful insights, fewer manual processes and exceptions, stronger preventive controls, faster execution of transformation initiatives, and greater ability to identify risks before they become problems. This leader will help build the technical and analytical foundation that enables APAR to evolve beyond transaction processing into a modern financial operations organization.
Required
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.
- 8+ years of experience in finance operations, financial systems, analytics, controls, technology or related functions.
- Leadership through others; experience managing and developing other people managers
- Experience with SOX controls and financial control environments.

Preferred
- Working knowledge of APIs, system integrations and modern data architectures.
- Strong technical mindset with the ability to translate between business, finance and technology organizations.
- Demonstrated process improvement and root-cause-analysis capability.
- Experience with business intelligence and visualization platforms such as Business Objects, Spotfire or equivalent.
- Strong SQL capability and experience working directly with large transactional datasets.
- Knowledge of B2B and/or B2C payment processes and payment technologies
- Strong understanding of accounts receivable and/or accounts payable processes.
- Experience standing up a new function or organization, from initial hire to operational maturity
- Demonstrated leadership of teams and complex cross-functional projects.
- Experience with PCI DSS and payment-card environments.
- Experience supporting international financial operations, regulatory requirements or global compliance frameworks.
- Python or comparable scripting/programming experience for analytics and automation.
- Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP or Oracle and understanding of APAR subledgers and general-ledger integration.
- Knowledge of data modeling, master data management, data lineage and data-quality frameworks.
- Experience with workflow automation, RPA or intelligent automation.
- Practical knowledge of generative AI, large language models, AI-enabled workflows and AI governance.
- Understanding of cybersecurity concepts relevant to financial operations, including identity and access management, encryption, tokenization and sensitive-data protection (PSD2/PSD3, data privacy laws)
- Experience with fraud detection, anti-money laundering, KYC, payment-risk analytics or continuous controls monitoring.
- Process/project management certification or experience

jobs.title: Program Management Engineer | HVDC
jobs.description:
Change the world. Love your job.

The High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) within the High Voltage Power business is seeking a technically skilled, energetic, competitive, and results-oriented leader who enjoys deploying new products and technologies to market as a Program Management Engineering.

In this role, you will lead new products from concept to release in partnership with other leaders in the organization and across TI. You will have the opportunity to learn and influence in emerging areas such as GaN new processes, package, IP and test for Datacenter ASSPs, Industrial and automotive applications. On this team, you will be a part of a professional and inclusive work environment where you are expected to challenge teammates to achieve flawless execution goals while maintaining strong working relationships.

Responsibilities include:

- Lead cross-functional teams through the complete product development lifecycle, inspiring flawless execution through effective meeting facilitation, clear communication channels, and meticulous documentation practices to ensure successful return on investment for all development initiatives

- Create and actively monitor comprehensive project plans including risk management, resource allocation, specification compliance, budget constraints, and schedule adherence.

- Inspire and lead cross-functional teams toward flawless product and project execution through effective meeting facilitation, clear communication channels, and meticulous documentation practices.

- Partner with wafer fabrication, assembly and test sites to guarantee schedule adherence, cost targets, and quality standards while coordinating with PPIT partners (ATD, SCP, Kilby Labs) to define, co-develop and release new technologies aligned with HVDC roadmap products

- Prepare and deliver weekly and monthly project status updates to stakeholders that clearly identify challenges and specific support needed to ensure successful outcomes.

- Serve as liaison between internal teams and external customers to communicate project status, coordinate key milestones, and manage deliverables, including sample distribution, custom requests, capacity planning, and quality validation processes.

- Collaborate with design and systems engineering teams to create and implement productivity enhancements for Core operations while enabling accelerated Spin deployment cycles

- Create and execute qualification plans in collaboration with Product Engineering and Quality Reliability Engineering teams

- Oversee product engineering testing to ensure integrated circuits meet specifications, reliability standards, and production readiness requirements while coordinating failure analysis investigations to determine root causes of issues and drive resolution.

- Maintain Galileo system per new product development guidelines from Assess Opportunity Phase to Release to Market and Production

- Effectively coordinate material logistics and shipment/assembly/test prioritization, setup new products in TI system using MMRs, SAP, SCS, PCS, ATSS, SWRs, others

- Success will be measured by the ability to consistently define a plan for a highly competitive product and deliver results according to the plan.
Minimum requirements:
- Bachelors in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related degree program
- 5+ years of experience with project engineering/management experience on highly complex products/projects

Preferred qualifications:
- Proven leadership capabilities in leading multifaceted global organizations
- Successful proven track record in indirect management and influence
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and set realistic plans based on required tasks with available resources
- Ability to effectively coordinate and lead global development teams on projects that include design, silicon fabrication, production test development, qualification and production ramp; Programs will be driven out of multiple global locations
- Ability to provide clear direction to both internal teams and external support organizations like device fabrication and assembly sites
- Knowledge of device packaging and wafer fabrication process
- Knowledge of reliability requirements and tri-temp characterization methodology using statistical analysis
- Ability to work in a team environment and understand cross-functional team dynamics along with the priorities
- Ability to work with global TI field and customers to align project schedules with customers’ key milestones
- Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Ability to influence (without direct authority) and lead teams as well as collaborate effectively with people in diverse functions and regions of the world
- Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
- Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
- Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Branch Manager to lead 200mm wafer FAB manufacturing operations and drive manufacturing excellence in a fast-paced production environment.  This role is well suited for a hands on, visionary leader with semiconductor operations experience and a strong IE foundation that is driven to achieve operational results.

Key Responsibilities

- Operational Leadership:

- Lead and Manage FAB manufacturing operations and the manufacturing team.  Ensure execution against daily, weekly, and quarterly goals, consistently meeting safety, quality and line performance objectives.

- Own line performance and lead daily constraint mitigation of tools, process flexibility, and labor through rapid issue resolution.

- Drive cross-functional coordination across all FAB branches and support functions to continuously improve and maintain stable factory activity & cycle time.

- Drive tactical leadership on a basis of data and manufacturing science principles to ensure site goals are met across safety, quality, activity and cost.

- Productivity and Automation:

- Own the utilization of factory automation assets at entitlement to enable maximum productivity for our team.

- Lead direct labor productivity improvements and automation readiness- optimize manufacturing workflows and eliminate tasks with partnership of the engineering teams to achieve best in class productivity and eliminate waste.

- Team Development and Leadership

- Lead, coach, and develop section managers and supervisors to sustain operations with consistent activity in a fast-paced 7x24 manufacturing environment.

- Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

- Set clear performance expectations and development priorities for leaders

- Define and execute a workforce roadmap to ensure the organization can meet current and future manufacturing needs.
Requirements & Qualifications :

- BS in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical field.

- 7 years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing operations with progressive management responsibilities. 200mm semiconductor experience preferred.

- Technical, Functional & Leadership Expertise

- Experience leading a team in a high volume manufacturing environment with direct accountability for line performance

- Demonstrated data-based decision making, problem-solving, and project management.

- Strong communications skills with the ability to concisely communicate to senior leadership and to all levels within the factory workforce (verbally & written).

- Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Support Teams, and between factories.

- Experience building an organizational structure to drive efficiencies and achieve results

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes

- Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills
